### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/test-typecheck-debt.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via ApprovalService (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via ApprovalService (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-1.mdx`  _(via ApprovalService (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/test-typecheck-debt.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **6** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 81d00a4ed938eb896859630498fc59d91183cf71` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3a4fb1f926754bf697d9493002c529ce2aabb8da` — the merge of head `10a61cc4b370976aad5fce482d7873eeb8035a24` into base `81d00a4ed938eb896859630498fc59d91183cf71`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3a4fb1f926754bf697d9493002c529ce2aabb8da && git checkout 3a4fb1f926754bf697d9493002c529ce2aabb8da
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 81d00a4ed938eb896859630498fc59d91183cf71 10a61cc4b370976aad5fce482d7873eeb8035a24 && git checkout -B drift-repro 81d00a4ed938eb896859630498fc59d91183cf71 && git merge --no-ff 10a61cc4b370976aad5fce482d7873eeb8035a24

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 81d00a4ed938eb896859630498fc59d91183cf71
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 81d00a4ed938eb896859630498fc59d91183cf71` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿)

- **改了什么**:审批节点里 `{ type: 'user', value }` 的审批人,若其 id 或邮箱在 `sys_user` 里查无此人,不再开一个谁也处理不了的待办;它记一条与团队、部门等审批人相同的「expanded to nobody」警告,不占位;整个名单因此为空时走节点的 `onEmptyApprovers`(默认 `admin_rescue`,交给组织管理员)。
- **为什么改**:写错 id 或人员已删除时,审批请求会永远挂在一个幽灵位上,不进任何人的待办,也没有任何日志。
- **风险与回滚**:存在性判断复用改派入口已有的谓词,且不带组织(不做租户筛选,符合 ADR-0105 D9);被封禁账户、跨组织的人、外出委托到的代理人、`sys_user` 读取失败都照旧保留原位。三条 dogfood 用例改为先注册对应账户;文档两句改正。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` 中 `resolveApproverSpec` 的 `user` 分支。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的**:无。非受管面,席位落地。

**席位意见:** ACCEPT。一个谓词、一条警告、复用已有的空名单路径;`field` 审批人与已删除代理人的同形缺口另开卡。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `10a61cc4b370976aad5fce482d7873eeb8035a24` · 2026-10-29T22:43Z

- **形态:** 24 files, +307/−53: `approval-service.ts` +42/−8, 14 test files (fixtures now seed the accounts they name), 3 dogfood pins and fixtures, two `approvals.mdx` sentences, the test-typecheck ledger (shrank by 2), one changeset. No `packages/spec`, no governed path; Tier S.
- **Clause-②:** `no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch`. No input is refused; an approver that names no account now routes through the node's existing `onEmptyApprovers` instead of a dead slot. No contract review owed.
- **前提实测:** `admin-rescue-named-slate` 4 of 21 red before the fix; ablation 1 (no existence check) 4 red, ablation 2 (no shared-warning widening) 3 red, both restored to the HEAD blob.
- **抽查读数:** the seat read the hunk: the check runs on the slot the out-of-office route ends on, skips a `type:value` literal, fails open on a thrown read, and calls `reassignTargetRefusal(value, null)` so no tenancy screen applies.
- **门禁 check-runs:** 54 on this head: 40 success, 14 skipped, 0 other (read 2026-10-29T22:43Z); `mergeable_state: clean`. Derived gates 94/94 exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED; plugin-approvals 1338/1338; nine approval dogfood files 9/9 (Dogfood Regression Gate does not run on PRs).
- **接受的偏差:** the wider file surface (stale fixtures, dogfood pins and two docs sentences this change made false), `reassignTargetRefusal` with no organization (ADR-0105 D9; the org screen reds two existing pins), the declared lock narrowing for intermediate runs (final-head runs under the lock), the report signature line, model-free trailers.
- **范围外去向:** `type: 'field'` ids and an out-of-office delegate that name no account → #27752.
- **散文面:** changeset and `approvals.mdx` checked against the diff by the seat.
- **落地条款:** relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the merge queue.
